newsitem.title: USA: M.A. Hanna sells rest of mining interests.
newsitem.headline: M.A. Hanna sells rest of mining interests.

text.p: The M.A. Hanna Co has sold its remaining interest in the mining industry with the sale of its 50 percent interest in the IOC Ore Sales Co.
The company said the sale was completed Friday to a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Iron Ore Co of Canada.

The sale ends a relationship with IOC dating from 1949, M.A Hanna said. The company held a 28 percent equity interest in IOC and sold 20 percent of that interest and 50 percent of its sales company interest to Mitsubishi in 1992. The remaining eight percent of the equity interest was sold back to IOC in 1995. M.A. Hanna acted as manager of IOC operations until the end of 1996.
